name: Raise Dead
description: Raise a corpse as an undead minion.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Launch a bolt of shadow energy at an enemy.

name: Life Tap
description: Convert your health into mana.

name: Drain Life
description: Drain health from an enemy to heal yourself.

name: Corpse Explosion
description: Cause a corpse to explode, damaging nearby enemies.

name: Bone Armor
description: Surround yourself with protective bones.

name: Death Coil
description: Fires a coil of death that damages enemies or heals undead.

name: Plague
description: Infect an enemy with a spreading disease.

name: Summon Skeleton
description: Summon a skeleton warrior to fight for you.

name: Bone Spear
description: Fire a spear made of bone that pierces enemies.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: Curse enemies to deal less damage.

name: Dark Pact
description: Sacrifice minion health for a powerful attack.

name: Army of the Dead
description: Raise a horde of undead to overwhelm enemies.

name: Desecrate
description: Create a zone of death energy that damages enemies.

name: Soul Harvest
description: Harvest souls from nearby enemies to empower yourself.

name: Fear
description: Strike terror into an enemy, causing them to flee.

name: Death Grip
description: Pull an enemy to your location with dark energy.

name: Lichform
description: Transform into a powerful lich temporarily.

name: Revive
description: Bring a fallen ally back as an undead.

name: Necrotic Blast
description: Release a blast of necrotic energy in all directions.
